svg.title: Antecedent / הקודם
svg.desc: Chapter 3, Hebrew p31, English p32. The selected violet Hypothetical Statement vocabulary retains two upright outlined dominoes and its exact dependency arrow. The left clause is enlarged and emphasized to identify the condition clause; the smaller partner preserves context. Both remain outlined because the hypothetical asserts their dependence without asserting either clause has occurred. Emphasis denotes the part being identified, not truth, certainty, amount, causal force, or temporal priority. This is a part-role of a hypothetical statement, not a Chapter 9 subtype. The Consequent part is distinct from the existing whole Consequent Statement icon.
